CustomField.description: When the work order was reported/synced from Yardi. Anchors all SLA math (used instead of CreatedDate so seed offsets are deterministic). Replaced Reported_Date__c, whose _Date suffix asserted a date-only type it never had - this field stores date AND time, per ARCHITECTURE.md §1 rule 9. Required: the legacy Reported_Date__c was retired in the 8-DateTime migration (D4) and this field took over as the required SLA anchor (D5).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Date AND time the work order was reported in Yardi. Every SLA calculation counts forward from this moment, so a wrong value silently re-tiers the work order's SLA health.
CustomField.label: Reported DateTime
